title: MONUMENT: ORIGINAL PANTRY, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT #255
text:
MONUMENT: ORIGINAL PANTRY, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT #255

  Plan Area: Downtown  Council District: 14 – Jurado

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  873 – 877 South Figueroa Street;
  809 – 813 West James M. Wood Boulevard

  Informational presentation on the proposed installation of two digital, rooftop displays on the Monument.
  Follow-up from July 16, 2026 meeting. Commission review and comment.

  Owner/
  Applicant:  Pope and Pantry LLC c/o Leo Pustilnikov

  Presenters:  Benjamin Anderson, Office Untitled; and Robert Chattel, Heritage Consulting Group
summary: The Cultural Heritage Commission will review and comment on a proposal to add two digital rooftop displays to the Original Pantry, a historic-cultural monument at 873 S Figueroa St downtown.
